refreshHint: 0 disables periodic synchronization. Pruning has its own schedule; resume may still start a task immediately.
pruneHint: 0 disables periodic pruning. Only runs when deletion synchronization is enabled for this source.
rescheduleHint: Cancel active/scheduled tasks and immediately reschedule synchronization plus enabled pruning using the saved settings. This affects every dataset linked to this connector.
logsHint: Sync imports source documents. Prune removes indexed documents absent from the supported source inventory; it does not import new documents. Counts describe recorded task progress, including failed or canceled tasks.
configGuide: Enter the listed fields in the JSON object below; dotted credentials fields are nested inside credentials. Saving checks persistence, not provider access. Unknown configuration keys are retained.
unsupportedDeletion: This source/configuration does not support deletion synchronization. Do not enable sync_deleted_files.
deletionScope: Deletion uses the complete configured inventory. Scope/account changes may require a rebuild. Keep source permissions stable; failed/partial inventories never confirm deletion.

guide.rest_api: Required: URL and one or more content_fields (array or comma-separated JSON paths). Optional items_path, id_field, metadata_fields, poll_timestamp_field. auth_type: none; api_key_header needs auth_config.header_name + credentials.api_key; bearer needs credentials.token; basic needs credentials.username/password. Pagination: none/page/offset/cursor; cursor needs pagination_config.next_cursor_path or next_cursor_field. URLs are checked by the backend. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.sharepoint: Graph app-only credentials, including the HTTPS site URL. Admin consent: Sites.Read.All and Files.Read.All. Reads the site libraries and files; source ACLs do not grant local dataset access. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.teams: Graph app-only credentials. Admin consent: Team.ReadBasic.All and ChannelMessage.Read.All. Each channel thread and replies form a document; attachments are represented by links/text, not downloaded binaries. Optional batch_size/sync_batch_size must be positive integers. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.onedrive: Explicit drive_ids array is required. [] selects no drives and never expands the scope; a connection probe rejects this empty scope. Optional folder_path selects a subtree (no . or ..). Admin consent: Files.Read.All. Optional batch_size/sync_batch_size: positive integers. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.outlook: Explicit user_ids array of unique mailbox IDs is required. [] selects no mailboxes and never expands the scope; a connection probe rejects this empty scope. Optional folder defaults to inbox only when omitted. Admin consent: Mail.Read. Attachments are not downloaded. Optional batch_size/sync_batch_size: positive integers. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.azure_blob: Set auth_mode explicitly and provide that mode’s credential fields. Optional prefix, allow_images and batch_size (integer 1–1000). SAS container_url must be an Azure HTTPS container URL without query parameters; put the SAS in sas_token. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.salesforce: Uses client credentials with an HTTPS Salesforce organization origin (no path/query). Omit objects for the default object set; [] selects none; a string array or comma-separated API names selects explicit objects. Optional api_version (e.g. v59.0), batch_size (integer 1–1000). Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.mssql: Requires a database-wide SELECT-only principal and a single SELECT query without INTO. Default port 1433. content_columns/metadata_columns are comma-separated column names. Configure a stable id_column for safe deletion; timestamp_column enables incremental rows. Account/query/column scope changes require rebuilding this dataset. Worker cursors are not editable.
guide.mysql: Default port 3306. content_columns/metadata_columns are comma-separated names. Optional SELECT query; table discovery requires database-wide SELECT. Stable id_column is needed for safe deletion. timestamp_column enables incremental rows. Rebuild after account/query/column scope changes; worker cursors are not editable.
guide.postgresql: Default port 5432. content_columns/metadata_columns are comma-separated names. Optional SELECT query. Stable id_column is needed for safe deletion. timestamp_column enables incremental rows. Rebuild after account/query/column scope changes; worker cursors are not editable.
guide.imap: Optional imap_port (default 993), imap_mailbox string array and poll_range days (default 30). Deletion inventory uses the original configured mailbox/time scope for each dataset. Rebuild after account/mailbox changes; worker state is not editable.
guide.moodle: Provide a Moodle Web Service token with course/content access. Deletion uses a complete visible course inventory; keep the token’s permissions stable.
guide.dingtalk_ai_table: Use the table ID, operator ID and access_token for the same table scope. Deletion uses the complete table inventory.
guide.zendesk: zendesk_content_type defaults to articles. Deletion synchronization is supported for articles only, not tickets.
guide.slack: Optional channels is an array of channel names (or CSV); omitted/null selects all visible channels, [] selects none. Bot needs channel listing/history/replies/user scopes and existing private-channel membership. Deletion sync is unavailable.
guide.s3: S3-compatible storage uses source=s3 and bucket_type=s3_compatible, not a separate source. That mode requires endpoint_url, access keys and addressing_style in credentials. To change bucket/prefix while deletion sync is on, turn deletion sync off first.
guide.google_drive: Choose the intended drive scopes explicitly. The existing OAuth control supplies google_tokens as a JSON string and google_primary_admin; service accounts use google_service_account_key. Retain refreshed credentials and unrelated source settings.
guide.gmail: Use the existing OAuth control or the documented Workspace service-account credential shape. google_tokens is a JSON string. Retain refreshed credentials and unrelated source settings.

configConflict: Source configuration changed while editing. Close and reopen settings before retrying; your draft has been kept.
deletionHint: An independent prune task removes missing indexed documents only after a complete, trusted source inventory is read.
deletionLifecycle: Off by default. Pruning runs on its own schedule, independent of the sync interval, and imports no new documents. Pagination, permission, read failures or cancellation never turn a partial inventory into success.
deletionOn: Enabled. A positive prune interval allows independent deletion cleanup tasks.
deletionOff: Disabled. Existing indexed documents are retained.
